name: r3a1-canonical-tool-names-no-wiki-rag-alias
description: R3a-1 Outcome 2 canonical tool-name contract: the one workspace knowledge dispatch table internal/workspacetools/registry.go must never resolve a wiki-rag tool name, so no former name (wiki_search, wiki_get_page, wiki_list_pages, wiki_find_related, code_search, code_get_file) is advertised or dispatched by the product. The REST parity surface resolves /workspaces/{workspace_id}/tools/{segment} through Registry.LookupREST and stores the resolved Kind; an unregistered segment has no Kind and is refused with the existing content-free NOT_FOUND before any evidence, source or question capability is entered. The weakening registers the wiki-rag token wiki_search as the search entry's REST subpath (`RESTPath: "search"` -> `RESTPath: "wiki_search"`), so the removed name becomes the dispatch segment for KindSearch and the route is accepted instead of refused. TestWorkspaceToolRESTUnregisteredSegmentIsNotFoundWithoutCapability requires every segment in {wiki_search, wiki_get_page} to resolve to NOT_FOUND with an empty dispatcher Kind and requires an unrecognised-tool dispatch to answer 404 NOT_FOUND without touching a capability, so the mutant is RED.
baseline_meaning: On the unmutated tree the canonical search entry carries RESTPath "search" and no registry entry or alias carries a wiki-rag token, so Registry.LookupREST("wiki_search") reports false, parseEndpointPath returns NOT_FOUND with an empty workspaceToolKind, and workspaceToolDispatch on an unrecognised segment answers 404 NOT_FOUND without entering a nil capability. TestWorkspaceToolRESTUnregisteredSegmentIsNotFoundWithoutCapability observes exactly that refusal.
mutant_meaning: With the search entry's REST subpath renamed to wiki_search, LookupREST("wiki_search") resolves the KindSearch entry, parseEndpointPath accepts the route with endpointWorkspaceToolSearch and a non-empty dispatcher Kind, and the removed wiki-rag name is dispatchable through /workspaces/{id}/tools/wiki_search. TestWorkspaceToolRESTUnregisteredSegmentIsNotFoundWithoutCapability fails the NOT_FOUND and empty-kind assertions, which is exactly the declared RED negative control (a wiki-rag name must never be advertised or dispatched), so the mutant is killed by the registered probe and not vacuous.
runner: tests/contracts/mutation-runner/main.go executes this case from tests/contracts/mutation-registry.json under the GO_UNIT harness for the invariant entry `acceptance.r3a1.tools.canonical-names-no-wiki-rag-alias`; the identical case is committed both here and in the registry so the proof is pinned to the product guard.
